spinner: The low sun on its day arc: an amber disc rises over a horizon line in the east, crosses the top and sets in the west.
skeleton: Soft rounded bands with a rust ember at their start, and a warm patch of low light sliding slowly across each, one after another.
switch: A pale crescent moon when off; on, the track warms from rust into amber and the moon becomes a sun with a soft halo.
check: An amber tick box with a warm halo, and a radio whose dot is a small sun; both warm up from a smaller, dimmer state.
toast: It rises over its own horizon: a dusk line along its foot, the toast coming up from behind it on a long, slow ease.
dialog: Sunrise: an amber glow spreads up from the bottom of the backdrop and the sheet, edged in amber on top, rises slowly into it.
tooltip: An ember in the dark: a soft rounded pill with a glowing amber dot before the words.
steps: The hours of the day: the passed hours glow from rust into amber, and the current step is the sun itself with its halo.
empty: The sun has set: half an amber disc on a horizon line, its last light spreading up behind a serif title.
link: A rust underline at rest; under the pointer the word catches the light, turning amber with a soft warm glow.
